subject.title: fix(browser): don't finalize/archive on implausibly short mid-stream captures (#284)

question: Is the live sub-16-character browser proof plus unit coverage enough to accept the residual timing-race risk for this completion guard?
rationale: The reported race is timing-dependent and was not staged end-to-end, so a maintainer has to decide whether proof of the shared guard branch is sufficient for this browser-capture change.

options.title: Accept current proof and land
options.body: Treat the live OK run, focused unit tests, and narrow diff as enough evidence for the timing-dependent guard.

options.title: Ask for stronger race diagnostics
options.body: Hold merge for a longer live run or diagnostic capture that shows a growing short stub under the new guard.

recommendation.title: Accept current proof and land
recommendation.body: Treat the live OK run, focused unit tests, and narrow diff as enough evidence for the timing-dependent guard.

likelyOwner.reason: The current source snapshot and release surface point to steipete as the best available owner for accepting browser-mode merge risk.
